gist.headline: A new canvas blooms
gist.blurb: ArtScape Studio has joined the garden: a free bilingual AI art studio for turning a small idea into a fresh image. Pick a style, ratio, and seed; the pixels do the rest.
gist.summary: Added ArtScape Studio to the Pollinations image app directory, a free Chinese/English AI art studio that lets people choose an idea, aspect ratio, style model, and seed before generating with the Pollinations image API.
gist.impact: Chinese- and English-speaking creators can now discover ArtScape Studio as a quick, configurable way to make unique Pollinations-powered artwork.
gist.visual_concept: Depict ArtScape Studio as a cozy bilingual artist workstation: Polli in a painter's beret helps compose a glowing canvas beside a retro terminal with simple Chinese and English idea notes, aspect-ratio frames, style swatches, and seed packets. Include blooming pixel flowers and code-plants to connect image generation with the Pollinations garden.
